title: On the Collapse of Generative Paths: A Criterion and Correction for Diffusion Steering (ICML 2026)
description: ACE detects when combining diffusion models makes a sampling path invalid and adjusts the guidance weights to repair it.

title: TRACE: Your Diffusion Model is Secretly an Instance Edge Detector (ICLR 2026 Oral)
description: TRACE locates the denoising step when object boundaries emerge and extracts instance edges from the model’s self-attention maps.

title: ISAC: Training-Free Instance-to-Semantic Attention Control for Improving Multi-Instance Generation (ECCV 2026)
description: ISAC stabilizes object layouts in self-attention, then binds each object to its prompt to improve multi-instance image generation.

title: Early Timestep Zero-Shot Candidate Selection for Instruction-Guided Image Editing (ICCV 2025)
description: ELECT ranks candidate seeds early in diffusion to preserve the background while applying the requested edit.

title: SPAW Romantic Relationship Test
description: A bilingual relationship-style assessment using topological data analysis of MIMARA and ROCI-II responses.
